# FG-EDGE-0001

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `release_definition_refuses_secret_like_file` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: edge-release.toml の内容が正しくありません（形、対象の機器、配るもの、シークレットらしいファイル）。直してからもう一度リリースしてください。
- en: edge-release.toml is not valid (its form, target devices, payloads or a secret-like file). Fix it and release again.
- id: edge-release.toml tidak valid (bentuk, perangkat sasaran, muatan, atau berkas yang tampak rahasia). Perbaiki lalu rilis lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 21 §5.2 (ADR-0041 §4): forge-edge's lint refused a repository's `edge-release.toml`. `reason`: `toml_syntax` (TOML error or an unknown key — nothing is ignored), `not_utf8`, `too_large` (> 64 KiB), `schema_version` (only 1), `arch` (only `amd64` / `arm64`), `os` (lower-case letters, digits, `.` and `-`, 1..=32 characters, e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`), `max_install_seconds` (1..=7200), `health_soak_seconds` (0..=86400), `no_payloads`, `payload_kind` (only `files` / `oci-image` / `agent`), `duplicate_kind` (one payload per kind), `agent_not_alone` (an `agent` payload is a release of its own), `no_artifacts`, `too_many_artifacts` (> 256 per payload), `artifact_path` (empty, absolute, a drive letter, `..` / `.` / empty segments, a backslash, a colon, control or non-ASCII characters, > 255 bytes), `duplicate_artifact` (also two paths that differ only by letter case), `secret_like_path` (a file name that looks like a secret: `.env`, `*.env`, `.env.*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p12` / `*.pfx` / `*.jks` / `*.keystore` / `*.ppk` / `*.kdbx`, `id_rsa*` / `id_dsa*` / `id_ecdsa*` / `id_ed25519*`, `.netrc`, `.pgpass`, `.npmrc`, `.htpasswd`, `credentials*`, `.git-credentials`, or a path under `.ssh/`, `.gnupg/`, `.aws/`, `.docker/`). Every problem is listed. Nothing was released.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The lint's problems list `reason` and `subject` (the field, payload kind or artifact path — never file content). The repository's `edge-release.toml` is the only input. From E4 the release builder records the problems on the release candidate.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix `edge-release.toml`: one payload per kind, relative artifact paths, a supported `arch` and `os`. Never put secrets in a release: per-device secrets belong to the device's own provisioning (plan 21 §5.2).
